description: Canonical dashboard for the future Django 'Link State & Traffic' page: interface admin/oper state, ingress/egress traffic rate, errors/discards, and raw counters, all derived from real gnmi_telemetry samples/counters. No packet-counter or utilization-percentage panel is fabricated: interface speed/capacity is not polled by any current collector, so only accurate bits-per-second rates are shown, never a percentage -- see docs/GRAFANA_MONITORING_TAXONOMY.md "Rate and utilization semantics".

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gnmi_telemetry" and r.category == "interface_state" and r._field == "admin_status")
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/ and r.interface =~ /^${interface:regex}$/ and ("${include_mgmt}" == "true" or not (r.interface =~ /^(Management|Vlan200)/)) and ("${include_loopback}" == "true" or not (r.interface == "lo" or r.interface =~ /^Loopback/)))
          |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "device", "interface"])
          |> group(columns: ["device", "interface"])

from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gnmi_telemetry" and r.category == "interface_state" and r._field == "oper_status")
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/ and r.interface =~ /^${interface:regex}$/ and ("${include_mgmt}" == "true" or not (r.interface =~ /^(Management|Vlan200)/)) and ("${include_loopback}" == "true" or not (r.interface == "lo" or r.interface =~ /^Loopback/)))
          |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "device", "interface"])
          |> group(columns: ["device", "interface"])

panels.description: Latest observed admin/operational state for every selected interface (not only non-UP, unlike the legacy exception views). 'Active only' = admin UP and oper UP. 'Hide down' removes oper-down interfaces.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: -15m)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gnmi_telemetry" and r.category == "interface_state" and (r._field == "admin_status" or r._field == "oper_status"))
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/ and r.interface =~ /^${interface:regex}$/ and ("${include_mgmt}" == "true" or not (r.interface =~ /^(Management|Vlan200)/)) and ("${include_loopback}" == "true" or not (r.interface == "lo" or r.interface =~ /^Loopback/)))
          |> group(columns: ["device", "platform", "interface", "_field"])
          |> last()
          |> group(columns: ["device", "platform", "interface"])
          |> pivot(rowKey: ["device", "platform", "interface"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
          |> filter(fn: (r) => ("${active_only}" == "false") or (r.admin_status == "UP" and r.oper_status == "UP"))
          |> filter(fn: (r) => ("${hide_down}" == "false") or (r.oper_status == "UP"))
          |> group()
          |> sort(columns: ["device", "interface"])

panels.title: Current interface state

panels.description: Non-negative derivative of streamed ingress/egress octet counters, converted to bits per second. Shown for the full selected time range regardless of current down/active state, so history is never retroactively hidden; use the ranking table below for a down/zero/active-filtered current view.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gnmi_telemetry" and r.category == "interface_counters" and (r._field == "in_octets" or r._field == "out_octets"))
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/ and r.interface =~ /^${interface:regex}$/ and ("${include_mgmt}" == "true" or not (r.interface =~ /^(Management|Vlan200)/)) and ("${include_loopback}" == "true" or not (r.interface == "lo" or r.interface =~ /^Loopback/)))
          |> group(columns: ["device", "interface", "_field"])
          |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
          |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 8.0}))

panels.title: Interface traffic rate

panels.description: Counter derivatives; any sustained value above zero deserves investigation.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gnmi_telemetry" and r.category == "interface_counters" and (r._field == "in_errors" or r._field == "out_errors" or r._field == "in_discards" or r._field == "out_discards"))
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/ and r.interface =~ /^${interface:regex}$/ and ("${include_mgmt}" == "true" or not (r.interface =~ /^(Management|Vlan200)/)) and ("${include_loopback}" == "true" or not (r.interface == "lo" or r.interface =~ /^Loopback/)))
          |> group(columns: ["device", "interface", "_field"])

panels.title: Error and discard rate

panels.description: Interfaces ranked by mean bits/second (ingress+egress combined series) over the selected range, joined against their latest observed admin/oper state. 'Active' is defined as admin UP and oper UP. This is the one panel where hide_zero_traffic/hide_down/active_only are all honored together, since it is a current ranking rather than a historical chart.

targets.query:
states = from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: -15m)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gnmi_telemetry" and r.category == "interface_state" and (r._field == "admin_status" or r._field == "oper_status"))
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/ and r.interface =~ /^${interface:regex}$/ and ("${include_mgmt}" == "true" or not (r.interface =~ /^(Management|Vlan200)/)) and ("${include_loopback}" == "true" or not (r.interface == "lo" or r.interface =~ /^Loopback/)))
          |> group(columns: ["device", "platform", "interface", "_field"])
          |> last()
          |> group(columns: ["device", "platform", "interface"])
          |> pivot(rowKey: ["device", "platform", "interface"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

        rates = from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gnmi_telemetry" and r.category == "interface_counters" and (r._field == "in_octets" or r._field == "out_octets"))
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/ and r.interface =~ /^${interface:regex}$/ and ("${include_mgmt}" == "true" or not (r.interface =~ /^(Management|Vlan200)/)) and ("${include_loopback}" == "true" or not (r.interface == "lo" or r.interface =~ /^Loopback/)))
          |> group(columns: ["device", "interface", "_field"])
          |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
          |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 8.0}))
          |> group(columns: ["device", "interface"])
          |> mean()

        join(tables: {s: states, r: rates}, on: ["device", "interface"])
          |> filter(fn: (r) => ("${active_only}" == "false") or (r.admin_status == "UP" and r.oper_status == "UP"))
          |> filter(fn: (r) => ("${hide_down}" == "false") or (r.oper_status == "UP"))
          |> filter(fn: (r) => ("${hide_zero_traffic}" == "false") or (r._value > 0.0))
          |> group()
          |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
          |> limit(n: 20)

panels.description: Latest raw octet/error/discard counters. Packet counters are not stored by the current collector and are intentionally not fabricated.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: -15m)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gnmi_telemetry" and r.category == "interface_counters")
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/ and r.interface =~ /^${interface:regex}$/ and ("${include_mgmt}" == "true" or not (r.interface =~ /^(Management|Vlan200)/)) and ("${include_loopback}" == "true" or not (r.interface == "lo" or r.interface =~ /^Loopback/)))
          |> group(columns: ["device", "platform", "interface", "_field"])
          |> last()
          |> group(columns: ["device", "platform", "interface"])
          |> pivot(rowKey: ["device", "platform", "interface"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
          |> group()
          |> sort(columns: ["device", "interface"])

panels.title: Latest interface counters

panels.description: Discrete read-only NETCONF <get> verification snapshots (device-level interface count), not streaming telemetry and not filtered per-interface.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "network-monitoring")
          |> range(start: -30d)
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "netconf_snapshot" and r._field == "interface_count")
          |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/ and r.platform =~ /^${platform:regex}$/)
          |> group(columns: ["device", "platform"])
          |> last()
          |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with snapshot_age_seconds: float(v: int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0}))
          |> keep(columns: ["device", "platform", "_time", "snapshot_age_seconds", "_value"])
          |> rename(columns: {_value: "interface_count"})
          |> group()
          |> sort(columns: ["device"])
